description: Real KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) op cases for kimi_linear_48b_a3b. DESCRIPTIVE FILE: the test .py files (test_kda_chunk.py / test_kda_e2e.py) drive this grid DIRECTLY via make_kda_inputs (KdaCase) and do NOT load this JSON; it documents the shape/dtype envelope and is kept in sync by test_cases_sync.py (which asserts this file matches _kda_test_common.chunk_grid() exactly). Shapes/dtypes are PROBED from a real KimiDeltaAttention.forward (see 'probe' below): FLA layout q,k,g [B,T,H,K]; v [B,T,H,V]; beta [B,T,H]; initial_state [B,H,V,K] fp32. K=V=128 (head_dim), H=32 in the real model (4 also tested), use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True, scale=K**-0.5. q/k/v bf16; g and beta fp32 (matching the model). gate 'rand' = realistic log-gate g=-5*rand in [-5,0]; gate 'ones' = worst-case g=-5 everywhere (cumulative ~-640, the subchunk=16 NaN-overflow case). seed=0 for all cases. Grid (B,T) extends beyond the probed real call to stress-test the envelope.

probe.source: KimiDeltaAttention.forward (one KDA layer, real config, bf16 model)
probe.note: q/k/v bf16; g and beta are fp32 (fused_kda_gate / .float().sigmoid()); initial_state fp32 [B,H,V,K], None on first prefill chunk.
